name: qa_tools
title: OS-H3A and OS-H3B (ADR 0014 slices H3a and H3b, ABI 1.5 and 1.6, new Community OS behaviour): Pattern F7 TOOLS and the RHYTHM GEN app from /modules/apps of a test card: the list of tool apps, the first-launch question, a block of 2 tracks x 16 rows as the app's context, APPLY (one undo unit), the 3/8 Euclid cycle, ROTATE, two lanes of different LENGTH, the exit chord back to Pattern with the block kept, UNDO and REDO naming the app. The notes are read from the shots (the app's text is not in the state line). The project is changed and put back by UNDO; nothing is written to the card. The second half (OS-H3B, QA-MOD-080..089 and QA-PAT-210..213) runs CHORDS, HUMANIZE, MUTATE and MORPH from the same card: a 3-track block, the chord progression written (CHORD FX), HUMANIZE over it, UNDO twice, MUTATE on the current sample instrument (the Params page before, after and after UNDO), MORPH to a second instrument and RESET

steps.say: OS-H3A rows QA-PAT-160..167 (Pattern F7 TOOLS) and QA-MOD-070..079 (RHYTHM GEN) of docs/qa/catalogue/pattern.md and modules.md (ADR 0014 slice H3a, ABI 1.5, new Community OS behaviour). Precondition: a TEST card with rhythmgen.tmod in /modules/apps (the packed file of o3m_rhythmgen_tmod: build-os-*/modules/rhythmgen.tmod; Tap Calc, if it is also there, is a tool too and is listed after it), a project loaded whose pattern 1 has at least 16 rows on tracks 1 and 2 and is EMPTY on them (use File NEW if unsure), the transport STOPPED, and a fresh `reset` just before the run when you want to see the first-launch question (QA-PAT-162: the unit asks once per boot per app). The list opens with the cursor on EXPORT PATTERN (the OS's own entry, above a rule): press Down once to put the cursor on the first tool app before F1 (F1 on EXPORT PATTERN starts a WAV export, QA-PAT-180). RHYTHM GEN is the first app below the rule when it is the only tool app but Tap Calc; with the four OS-H3B apps on the card (chords, humanize, morph, mutate) it sorts AFTER them: press Down until the cursor is on RHYTHMGEN before F1 (the list is EXPORT PATTERN, EXPORT SELECTION when there is a block, a rule, then the apps by name). Nothing is written to the card; the project is changed by the app and put back by UNDO

steps.say: OS-H3B rows QA-MOD-080..089 and QA-PAT-210..213 (ADR 0014 slice H3b: ABI 1.6, CHORDS, HUMANIZE, MUTATE, MORPH; new Community OS behaviour). Precondition: a TEST card with chords.tmod, humanize.tmod, morph.tmod, mutate.tmod and rhythmgen.tmod in /modules/apps (the packed files of o3m_*_tmod: build-os-*/modules/*.tmod), a project whose pattern 1 has at least 16 rows on tracks 1 to 3 and is EMPTY on them, the transport STOPPED. The CURRENT instrument (the one in the Pattern's instrument field) must be a SAMPLE instrument (any sample, even a short one) for MUTATE and MORPH, and a SECOND sample instrument with the same play engine (INST page: PLAY ENGINE, the default AUTO is fine) must exist for MORPH to have a SOURCE; if the current instrument is a MIDI instrument CHORDS starts in CHORD FX mode, on a sample instrument in SPREAD (the steps below set CHORD FX by hand either way). Every editing app asks once per boot on its first launch (F1 again): the steps press F1 twice and the second press is ignored when it is not needed. The list is EXPORT PATTERN, EXPORT SELECTION (with a block), a rule, then CHORDS, HUMANIZE, MORPH, MUTATE, RHYTHMGEN by name: the Down counts below assume exactly those and a block that stays selected while the Params page is looked at (if the block was lost, F7 has no EXPORT SELECTION and every count is one too many: check the cursor in the shot of the list before F1). The project is changed by the apps and put back by UNDO; nothing is written to the card
